description: Delete a file from a private Space. If you send version, it must match the file's current version or the call is refused. Exact retries can't bring the file back.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

name: space_file_delete
title: Delete a file
